title: Launch taste
description: Taste for motion-design launch, feature and brand films: how to choose the concept device and the style family that communicate this product's one idea, and how to give it restraint, contrast, a well-placed peak and sound that lands on the picture. A decision path from message to the one thing the viewer must feel, to device, style, motion personality and sound, with a style map (what each look says, what it suits and fails for), reusable concept devices, sound-to-picture rules and anti-patterns learned from real launch films. Read it with the owner skill.
summary: Choose the device, style, motion personality and sound that make a launch film feel intentional, with the anti-patterns to avoid.

requires.why: The taste test is run on captured frames: frame 0, the breath, the peak and the end card.
